text: The Cord End leads to a hidden door in a ravine that can only be opened by whoever holds it.

The secret cave reached via the Cord End contains the remains of one girl along with three Sacrificial Twigs; this mysterious corpse, wearing noble clothing rather than armor (suggesting high status), is never explained in any in-game text, leaving its identity a complete mystery.
Numerous fingerprints appear on the Night Giant's body, which may hint at an in-world connection to the Fingers from Elden Ring lore.
